test_title: PYST 09: SSC JE EE - General Intelligence (Held on 07 Jun 2024 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
In a certain code language,

'A + B' means 'A is the mother of B',

'A - B' means 'A is the brother of B',

'A × B' means 'A is the sister of B', and

'A ÷ B' means 'A is the husband of B'.

How is H related to E if 'A - B ÷ H + C × D + E'?
solution:
Family Chart:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2a776c0a19b6706031165c847bcb98978a1e150482bd1260c12a74559ea55407.png] 

Decoding the Symbols:

 
 

 Symbol
 +
 -
 ×
 ÷
 
 

 Meaning
 Mother
 Brother
 Sister
 Husband
 
 

 

Given: A - B ÷ H + C × D + E

It means:

 
• A is the brother of B
 
• B is the husband of H
 
• H is the mother of C
 
• C is the sister of D
 
• D is the mother of E

Based on the relationships:

 
• H is the mother of C, and C is the sister of D.
 
• Therefore, H is also the mother of D.
 
• Since D is the mother of E, H is the mother of D, who is the mother of E.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/10e90d38856bb5c5bfd6ce9ec085320991e90f1f4b2fa2d194dda00ee3027903.png] 

So, H is the **mother's mother** of E.

Hence, the correct answer is option 1.
